title: KickCD — cast bar, glow gate, defaults and lint
cluster_summary: Five unrelated KickCD-local findings with no upstream root cause. Each fix, if made, lands in KickCD. Only KC-R-01 is a real player-visible bug: an empty icon grid leaves the cast bar anchored to a released pooled button on the default PRIMARY anchor mode. It is a one-line fix plus a characterization test and must be addressed. KC-R-08 is cheap lint hygiene and should be done using the corrected 44-name removal list. KC-R-05 is an owner semantic call and is optional. KC-R-06 and KC-R-07 do not need code now; KC-R-07 should be tracked as a triaged issue with its trigger.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: Castbar_Events.lua:254 copies primaryIcon only when non-nil, while IconGrid.lua:495 announces nil for an empty grid. The cache therefore keeps a released, unanchored pooled button, and ApplyAnchor never reaches the resolveGridFrame fallback on the default PRIMARY mode. No test covers OnGridLayout.
verdicts.remediation: In Castbar:OnGridLayout, assign inst.lastGridLayout.primaryIcon = payload.primaryIcon unconditionally (including nil), and update the misleading 'defensive' comment. Add a characterization test: drive OnGridLayout with a populated payload, then with primaryIcon=nil, and assert that ApplyAnchor anchors to resolveGridFrame. Record an owner in-client smoke check (empty the spell list or switch to a spec with no learned spell, cast bar stays visible) and do not mark it passed.

verdicts.assessment: Real mismatch: the gate tuple uses IsHostileUnitCasting, while the target_casting trigger uses any cast. The default trigger is 'never', the effect is a cosmetic missing or stale glow, and the right fix depends on what the owner intends target_casting to mean.
verdicts.remediation: Owner decision. If target_casting means a hostile cast (likely for an interrupt tracker), make the trigger use State.IsHostileUnitCasting so it matches the gate. If it means any cast, add the raw casting state to the RefreshAllGlows gate tuple. Add a characterization test for the chosen semantics.

verdicts.assessment: Accurate: section 'general' (master rows, grid drag-stop, and the panel move at Panel_Render.lua:484) triggers a Cooldowns rebuild. But it is config-time only, throttled and unmeasured, and narrowing it risks the 'enabled' rebuild path. That is not worth it without a perf-analysis capture showing hitches.
Real latent design gap, but no profile is affected: no spec has been added to defaults/Spells.lua since launch. The finding itself recommends deferring until a trigger fires.
verdicts.remediation: No code change. File a KickCD GitHub issue (state:triaged, severity:low) recording the trigger: when a spec is first added to defaults/Spells.lua, seed missing (class, spec) pairs individually in Database:BuildSpells.

verdicts.assessment: The lint slack is real, but the review over-counted readers (it counted _G.X, comments and mock field assignments) and its 'move to files[tests/]' remedy is wrong. libs/ and tests/_kit/ are excluded from lint, and spot checks agree with the reality lens: those names have no bare reader in linted files. Leaving them whitelisted hides real false negatives, such as the legacy UIDropDownMenu_AddButton. The fix is cheap, and it was already flagged once before (F-016).
verdicts.remediation: Remove the 44 read_globals with no bare reader in any linted file (the reality-lens list: _G, GetTime, GetTimePreciseSec, GameFontNormal, GameFontHighlight, GameFontDisable, STANDARD_TEXT_FONT, hooksecurefunc, securecallfunction, issecretvalue, C_Timer, C_Spell, C_SpecializationInfo, GetLocale, InCombatLockdown, PlaySound, UnitCastingInfo, UnitChannelInfo, UnitExists, UnitCanAttack, UnitGUID, UnitName, UnitIsDead, IsLoggedIn, UISpecialFrames, UIDropDownMenu_AddButton, CreateColorFromHexString, WrapTextInColorCode, CopyTable, wipe, tContains, tinsert, tremove, strsplit, strtrim, strjoin, date, time, BackdropTemplateMixin, CreateFromMixins, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR, RED_FONT_COLOR, GREEN_FONT_COLOR). Keep the 24 bare-read names. Do not add a files["tests/"] read_globals stanza. Re-run luacheck and confirm 0/0; restore any name luacheck then flags.
